Description.body: Don't use both `-URI` and `doc_data`. If `-URI` is specified, the document data will be read from the path specified by `-URI`, which must be available for a processor of the current API, typically it is a docker container. Otherwise if `doc_data` is specified, the document data will be used as a value of `doc_data`. The value must be encoded in BASE64. Use `base64 -w 0 <FILE PATH>` to encode the data. Returns a 'unique_id' of the document if the insertion succeeded
Description.footer: Examples of correct queries: `echo "-metadata=txt doc_data=`base64 -w 0 <FILE PATH>`"> /api/api.pmccabe_collector.restapi.org/ai_agent/rag/add_doc/v1/PUT/exec` or `echo "-URI=<FILE PATH> -metadata=txt"> /api/api.pmccabe_collector.restapi.org/ai_agent/rag/add_doc/v1/PUT/exec`
